title: Silica‐supported ICl as a novel heterogeneous system for the rapid oxidation of urazoles to triazolinediones
abstract: AbstractICl–SiO2 as a new reactive system was prepared by the treatment of iodine monochloride with an activated silica gel in chloroform. ICl–SiO2 in a heterogeneous system efficiently oxidized urazoles to the corresponding triazolinediones under mild conditions in high yields at room temperature. © 2008 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. Heteroatom Chem 19:389–393, 2008; Published online in Wiley InterScience (www.interscience.wiley.com). DOI 10.1002/hc.20444
